system.description: • Effect: Once per encounter, as part of an attack, mark a creature you can see. The mark lasts the encounter, on one creature at a time. You have Advantage on your next attack roll against it, hit or miss, or on your next Track check to follow it.

activities.name: Marked Prey
activities.text: As part of an attack, mark a creature you can see for the encounter (one at a time): Advantage on your next attack roll against it, hit or miss, or on your next Track check to follow it.
